name: keep-warm
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while you are away by forking the conversation shortly before it expires, only when the expected saving pays for it and for a few refreshes at most.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: The lifetime your sessions write the cache with. auto reads CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL and FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, else assumes 5m. keep-warm never changes it.

idleLimit.title: Idle refreshes
idleLimit.description: Refreshes at most while you are away, 0 to 10; 0 turns warming off.

minSavingUsd.title: Minimum expected saving (USD)
minSavingUsd.description: A refresh is sent only when it is expected to save at least this much, at API list prices.
